client_need: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control
stem: A hospitalized client has fever and a generalized pruritic rash with macules, papules, vesicles, and crusted lesions present at the same time. Varicella is suspected. Which precautions are appropriate?

options.A: Airborne and Contact Precautions in addition to Standard Precautions until lesions are dry and crusted.
options.C: Droplet Precautions only until the fever resolves.

rationale: Varicella lesions characteristically appear in different stages simultaneously. CDC infection-control guidance requires Airborne and Contact Precautions, in addition to Standard Precautions, for patients with varicella until lesions have dried and crusted.
educational_objective: Initiate appropriate transmission-based precautions for varicella.
source_organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
